prompt: As of August 3rd 2024, which movie using the Technicolor dye-transfer process was the last to win the Academy Award for Best Picture?
answer:
The last Best Picture winner using Technicolor’s dye-transfer printing process was **_The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ (2003)**. It won Best Picture at the **76th Academy Awards in 2004**.

This refers to the process used to make the film’s release prints; it was not necessarily photographed using the original three-strip Technicolor camera process.
